services.title: Workflow Automation
services.description: I map how your business actually handles leads, then build automations where every lead always has a next step. If something fails, it retries or alerts you. You get follow-up that runs on its own, and no leads slip through.

services.title: Funnel Building
services.description: I map the path someone takes from first click to booked appointment, then build every step of it. If they stall or drop off, the page catches them instead of losing them. You get a funnel that works on any phone and holds up when traffic hits it.

services.title: AI & Prompts
services.description: I use AI to help build the automations, then test every path before I hand it over. If something would break, I find it first instead of you finding it later. You get the same dependable result every time, without the build taking longer.

services.title: API Integrations
services.description: I connect the apps you already use so they keep each other up to date. If two don’t talk on their own, I wire them another way — Make, Zapier and n8n included. You get one place where your data stays in sync.

services.title: No-Code / Low-Code
services.description: I can build this without code, and I can write code when that’s the better route. That means later changes are easy, whether you make them or I do. You get something that stays easy to update instead of locked in.

subs.title: Contacts Import

subs.title: Smart Lists

skills.title: Pipelines & Opportunities

Track deals from first contact to close — custom stages and opportunity movement.
Automation-aware — pipeline movement feeds follow-up sequences.
skills.desc: In GHL, I create and manage Pipelines and Opportunities to visualize and track deals from first contact to close — configuring custom stages, moving opportunities as leads progress, and tying pipeline movement into automations and follow-up sequences.

subs.title: Pipeline Builder
subs.desc: Configure pipelines with custom stages that match how the business sells — from first contact to close.

subs.title: Opportunity Management

subs.title: Automation Integration

subs.desc: Set up round robin, personal, and group calendars for different booking flows.

subs.title: Availability & Booking Rules
subs.desc: Configure availability windows and booking rules that control when and how leads book.

subs.title: Automation Triggers
subs.desc: Connect calendars to forms and funnels, and trigger reminders, follow-ups, and no-show sequences off booking events.

skills.title: Workflows & Automations
skills.short:
Build multi-step GHL/Make.com automations — defensive suppression, Stripe·Sheets·Slack, lead routing, dormant win-back, Conversation AI.
Tailored to how your business actually runs — tested live, fixed before it reaches your customers.
skills.desc: I build custom GHL/Make.com automations tailored to how your business actually runs — not generic templates. Whether it's routing leads the moment they come in, following up automatically so no one falls through the cracks, connecting your tools so data flows without manual work, or re-engaging cold leads before they're gone for good — I design the workflow around your process, test it live, and fix what breaks before it reaches your customers.

skills.title: Funnels & Websites
skills.short:
Build the front door — clear funnels, landing pages, and capture flows inside GHL.
Turn first clicks into qualified conversations, then hand off cleanly to the rest of your system.
skills.desc: I build conversion-focused funnels and websites in GoHighLevel — landing pages, funnel steps, forms, and thank-you pages that give visitors a reason to keep moving. I shape the page around the offer, connect each capture point to the contact record, and make the handoff into calendars, pipelines, and automations feel natural.

skills.title: Marketing
skills.short:
Run end-to-end marketing in GHL — email campaigns with analytics, social scheduling, and reusable snippets.
Performance-aware — built-in analytics, trigger links, and a consistent brand across every asset.

I use the Social Planner to schedule and manage posts across multiple platforms from one place. I create reusable SMS and Email Snippets to speed up messaging and keep communication consistent. I also build Brand Boards to maintain consistent colors, fonts, and logos across all marketing assets.

subs.title: Social Planner

subs.title: Countdown Timers

subs.title: Trigger Links

subs.title: Brand Boards

skills.title: Custom Objects
skills.short:
Model the things a business actually sells — vehicles, pets, properties, students, treatment packages.
Not just the people who buy them.
skills.desc: I design custom data structures in GoHighLevel — vehicles, pets, properties, students, treatment packages — so businesses can track the things they actually sell and service, not just the people who buy them. Custom objects let me model real inventory and service records, link them back to the contact, and give the whole system a data backbone instead of cramming everything into free-text notes.

subs.title: Vehicle Custom Object
subs.desc: One of the custom objects I model: a Vehicle object with fields for make, model, year, plate number, last service date, next service due, and mileage. Associated as one contact to many vehicles — so a workflow can text "Your Toyota Vios is due for an oil change" based on that vehicle's next service date, not the contact's. Activity tracks per vehicle, which is exactly what a TorqueWorks-style dormant win-back needs.

skills.title: Snapshots & Sub-Account Setup
skills.short:
Package a full GHL setup — funnels, calendars, pipelines, workflows, forms, templates — into a reusable Snapshot.
A new client sub-account goes from empty to live in minutes, not days.
skills.desc: I package a complete GoHighLevel setup into a reusable Snapshot — funnels, calendars, pipelines, workflows, forms, and templates captured as one template. A new client sub-account loads from empty to live in minutes instead of days, with the structure, copy, and automations already proven from a previous build instead of rebuilt from scratch.

skills.title: PSGCIMBTFLO — Automation Building System
skills.short: My 11-step system for shipping client automations — scoped live on discovery calls, built in GHL, tested with proof, optimized under retainer.
skills.desc: PSGCIMBTFLO is the acronym system I run on every client build: Problem, Solution, Goal, Customer Journey, Identify Pipeline Stage, Mapping, Build, Test, Final Revision, Live, Optimize. It turns vague asks into specific problems, anchors each automation to a customer journey, mirrors that journey into pipeline stages, and never calls a build done until it's tested with proof.

subs.title: Problem
subs.desc: Identify the specific problem or need — never build on vague answers. Probe until the real need is concrete.

subs.title: Solution
subs.desc: The fix isn't always an automation — a pipeline, form, calendar, landing page, notification, nurture sequence, or a combination. Clear problem → clear solution.

subs.title: Goal
subs.desc: Every system needs an ending. Agree the client's desired outcome and start with one goal so the build stays focused.

subs.title: Customer Journey
subs.desc: The anchor of the automation. Map each step a lead takes to reach the goal — it doesn't have to be perfect, just clear.

subs.title: Identify Pipeline Stage
subs.desc: Pipeline stages mirror the customer journey — one stage per meaningful change, so the pipeline reads the journey back to you.

subs.title: Mapping
subs.desc: For each stage define the trigger (how the contact enters) and the action steps — every action must lead the contact to the next stage.

subs.title: Build
subs.desc: Build it in GoHighLevel or the chosen tool with a keeper-simple structure — no overcomplication.

subs.title: Test
subs.desc: Never say done until tested. Test the real trigger (actually book, actually submit) and screenshot or record the pass as your proof receipt.

subs.title: Final Revision
subs.desc: Optional review loop — clients may add, revise, or edit after testing. Rinse and re-test before going live.

subs.title: Live
subs.desc: Publish once the client confirms and testing is clean.

subs.title: Optimize
subs.desc: The role doesn't stop at go-live — this is the retainer. Weekly check-ins, open/click rates, A/B copy tests, and conditional-logic fixes.
